shell.forbidden: The backoffice is reserved for the Messer team.
shell.forbiddenImpersonating: You are impersonating a user. Stop impersonating from the banner at the top to return to the backoffice.

metrics.title: Business metrics
metrics.description: Real data from subscriptions, usage and invoices. Updated {date}.
metrics.pastDueHint: {count, plural, =0 {None past due} one {# past due} other {# past due}}
metrics.costVsRevenueHint: Real model cost and value of the credits consumed (USD), per month.
metrics.noUsage: It appears once organizations run agents or workflows on paid models.
metrics.signupsHint: New users over the last 12 weeks.
metrics.funnelHint: Organizations created in the last 90 days that reached each step.

orgs.title: Organizations
orgs.description: Plan, payment status, usage, real model cost and margin of every organization (current month).
orgs.search: Search by name, slug or owner email
orgs.usageCell: {members, plural, one {# user} other {# users}} · {projects, plural, one {# project} other {# projects}} · {runs, plural, one {# run} other {# runs}}
orgs.footnote: AI cost = real model cost (USD). Margin = value of credits consumed − AI cost. Annual MRR is prorated /12.

detail.subtitle: {slug} · created {date} · {region}
detail.creditsDescription: Recorded as an adjustment in the credit ledger, with your name and the note, and audited.
detail.noteHint: Required. The customer sees it in their transactions.
detail.planDescription: For deals outside the website (for example Enterprise invoiced separately) or to extend a trial.
detail.planProviderNote: The organization has a paid subscription: the change is also applied at the payment provider, prorated.
detail.blockDescription: Nobody can create or run anything in the organization until it is unblocked. Give the reason (audited).
detail.reasonRequired: Give a reason of at least 3 characters.

users.title: Users
users.description: Find users, log in as them for support and block accounts.
users.blockDescription: All their sessions are closed and they cannot log in again until unblocked.
users.unblockDescription: They will be able to log in again.

impersonate.title: Log in as {email}
impersonate.description: You will see Messer exactly as this user, with a visible banner. Every action is audited under your name. The session lasts at most 2 hours.
impersonate.reasonHint: Required, for example the support ticket number.

plans.title: Plans
plans.description: Prices and limits are configuration. With Stripe configured, each price change creates new Stripe prices and archives the old ones.
plans.formDescription: Prices exclude VAT, in euros. −1 in a limit means unlimited.
plans.liveWarning: {count, plural, one {There is # subscription on this plan.} other {There are # subscriptions on this plan.}} New limits apply immediately; new prices apply to new subscriptions and renewals.
plans.idHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes. Cannot be changed.
plans.limitsHint: Users, projects, runs per month, credits per month and GB.
plans.syncSimulated: Billing is in test mode: there is nothing to sync with Stripe.
plans.syncChanged: Stripe updated with the new prices.
plans.syncUnchanged: Stripe was already up to date.
plans.footnote: Organizations already paying keep their Stripe price until they change plan.

prices.title: Model prices
prices.description: Cost per million tokens (USD) used to compute the real cost of every run and the credits consumed.
prices.formDescription: Prices per million tokens in USD, as published by the provider.
prices.modelHint: provider/model format, as in the model configuration.
prices.deleteDescription: Runs on this model will no longer have a computed cost. To stop using it, mark it inactive instead.
prices.empty: Add each model's price to compute costs and credits.
prices.footnote: Credits apply the configured margin (MESSER_CREDIT_MARGIN) on top of these costs.

templates.title: Templates
templates.description: Visibility and order of the industry templates on the website and in the app.
templates.empty: Templates appear here once they are loaded into the catalog.

flags.title: Feature flags
flags.description: Turn features on for everyone or only for some plans or organizations.
flags.formDescription: "Enabled" is the master switch. If you pick plans or organizations, it is on only for them.
flags.keyHint: Lowercase letters, numbers, dots and dashes. Cannot be changed.
flags.deleteDescription: Code checking it will see it as disabled.
flags.empty: Create a flag to roll out features gradually.

audit.title: Backoffice audit
audit.description: Actions by superadmins and the system across every organization.
audit.prefixHint: Filter by prefix, for example admin. or billing.
